revision: the section pages read 14 Nov 2026 22:3x-22:5x +04 (SHA-256 of each page in section_info)
holder_unknown: not named in the section's table
holder_sources: the reference in the last column of the section's table, from its list of references
pending_queue: Packomania's list of pending requests (pending.html, dated 9 Nov 2026, read 14 Nov) holds thousands of unreviewed candidates, by section and range of N (for example 1,456 for the eight rectangles, 2,213 and 1,813 for csq, 587 and 17 for ssp); their values are not published, so a cell's best known value is the table's, and a candidate in the queue may already beat it
title: Circles of radii 1, 2, ..., N packed in the smallest circle or square

template.title: Circles of radii 1 to {n} in the container of Packomania section {section}
template.statement: Place {n} non-overlapping circles of radii 1, 2, ..., {n} in the container of section {section} whose size V (the radius of the circle, or the side of the square) is as small as possible.
template.submission: Text file: V on the first line, then {n} lines with the centres of the circles of radius 1, 2, ..., {n} in that order (decimal numbers), in the frame given by checkers/pack_check.py for section {section}.

score: the size V of the container (smaller is better)
best_text: The best known container in Packomania's table has size {best} ({holder}); a valid packing in a smaller one improves it.
open_rule: every N of the sections ccin, csqn and sspn (balls of radii 1..N in a ball) whose value is not in bold (proven optimal), N >= 4
left_out: ccin: 0 proven, 3 small N; csqn: 0 proven, 3 small N; sspn: 0 proven, 2 small N; the sections with radii i^(1/2), i^(-1/2), i^(-2/3) and i^(-1/5) (irrational radii)
